errors.cannotReach: web_search: cannot reach the Perplexity endpoint {endpoint} — try: check your network or proxy, then retry, or switch engines in Settings (General page).
errors.missingKey: web_search: Perplexity backend requires an API key — set PERPLEXITY_API_KEY env var or `perplexityApiKey` in ~/.reasonix/config.json; get one at https://perplexity.ai/settings/api
errors.unauthorized: web_search: Perplexity API key rejected — check PERPLEXITY_API_KEY or get one at https://perplexity.ai/settings/api
errors.rateLimit: web_search: Perplexity rate-limited — wait and retry, or switch engines in Settings (General page).
errors.serverError: web_search: Perplexity server error ({status}) — try again later, or switch engines in Settings (General page).
errors.parseError: web_search: Perplexity returned unparseable response (HTTP {status}) — try again later
